# Runbook: Operation/incident

- Owner/on-call/escalation:
- Last tested/date/version:
- Related service, SLO, alert and control:

## Trigger and impact

Symptoms, affected critical operation/data/tenants, severity and stop-the-line criteria.

## Safety and authority

Prerequisites, access, approvals, maker-checker, evidence capture, actions that are forbidden.

## Diagnose

Read-only checks first; expected healthy/unhealthy evidence and decision points.

## Contain

Bound impact while preserving financial integrity, evidence and recoverability.

## Recover

Exact scoped steps, idempotency, rollback/roll-forward and abort/escalation criteria.

## Validate and reconcile

Technical health, ledger/control totals, external/GL status, audit completeness and customer impact.

## Communicate and close

Stakeholder/regulatory clocks, evidence locations, follow-up actions, post-incident review and retest.
